heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(1), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1458

notes.text: Section 2602, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLIV, § 4422, formerly Pub. L. 101–189, div. C, title XXXI, § 3156, Nov. 29, 1989, 103 Stat. 1683; renumbered Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLIV, § 4422, and amended Pub. L. 108–136, div. C, title XXXI, § 3141(g)(12), Nov. 24, 2003, 117 Stat. 1766; Pub. L. 113–66, div. C, title XXXI, § 3146(a)(2)(E), (e)(11), Dec. 26, 2013, 127 Stat. 1073, 1077, related to reports in connection with permanent closures of Department of Energy defense nuclear facilities. See section 6191 of Title 10, Armed Forces.

Section 2603, Pub. L. 107–314, div. D, title XLIV, § 4423, as added Pub. L. 114–92, div. C, title XXXI, § 3133(a), Nov. 25, 2015, 129 Stat. 1205; amended Pub. L. 117–263, div. C, title XXXI, § 3114, Dec. 23, 2022, 136 Stat. 3053, related to development and submission to Congress of plans for deactivation and decommissioning of nonoperational defense nuclear facilities. See section 6194 of Title 10, Armed Forces.

Defense Site Acceleration CompletionPub. L. 108–375, div. C, title XXXI, § 3116, Oct. 28, 2004, 118 Stat. 2162, as amended by Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(c)(2)(L), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1461, which related to definition of high-level radioactive waste and monitoring by Nuclear Regulatory Commission of disposal actions, was repealed by Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(16), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1459. See section 6192 of Title 10, Armed Forces.

Sandia National LaboratoriesPub. L. 108–199, div. H, § 127, Jan. 23, 2004, 118 Stat. 440, which prohibited obligation of funds to pay certain expenses related to closure or post-closure care and monitoring of Sandia National Laboratories, was repealed by Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(17), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1459. See section 6193 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
